items.title: Session and token handling
items.remediation: Store sessions in httpOnly Secure cookies or platform Keychain-equivalents

items.title: No hardcoded credentials
items.remediation: Move secrets to env or a secret manager

items.title: Middleware alone is not complete authorization
items.remediation: Call shared requireUser/requireRole helpers inside Server Actions, Route Handlers, and data loaders—not only middleware.

items.title: Secure session cookie flags
items.remediation: Set HttpOnly + Secure + appropriate SameSite on session cookies in production.

items.title: Authorize every HTTP method
items.remediation: Apply shared auth helpers in each exported method

items.title: Object-level authorization
items.remediation: Derive identity from the authenticated session and enforce ownership checks on every object operation.

items.title: Server Actions input trust
items.remediation: Schema-validate all Server Action arguments and enforce object-level authorization using the session.
